description:
Debloat your face with a daily scan and a personalized anti-retention plan.

Process Debloat helps reduce facial puffiness linked to water retention, sleep, hydration, and nutrition.

WHAT YOU DO EVERY DAY
• Daily face scan: retention, under-eyes, jawline, skin, estimated cortisol
• Clear checklist so you always know what to do next
• Guided hydration
• Debloat meals and meal photo analysis
• Sleep and recovery built into your protocol
• AI coach focused on your face

WHY PROCESS
• A personal anti-retention protocol
• Concrete scores to track progress
• A simple loop: scan → actions → results

If your face looks puffy in the morning, start today.
